name: Ironfast Outpost
description: A dwarven military fortress carved into the mountainside. Stone halls echo with the ring of hammers and the march of disciplined boots. Discipline is absolute, trust is earned.

shops.name: Master Durin's Forge
shops.specialty: Dwarven-crafted arms and armor of exceptional quality

barracks.name: Soldier's Rest
barracks.description: Austere stone bunks and military precision. Dwarves only—unless you've proven yourself.

consecrate_weapon.description: Bless a weapon against evil creatures (+1 vs evil for 1 day)

commander_thrain.name: Commander Thrain Ironfoot
commander_thrain.description: A grizzled dwarf with a braided white beard and scars from countless battles. His eyes are hard but fair.

dialogue.greeting: State your business, outsider. We've no time for tourists.
dialogue.episode_04_briefing: The duergar took our lower hold. Help us reclaim it, and you'll have earned our respect.
dialogue.after_episode_04: You fought well. Ironfast remembers its allies. You're welcome here, friend.

master_durin.name: Master Durin Hammerhand
master_durin.description: A broad-shouldered dwarf whose arms are thick as tree trunks. His hammer never stops ringing against the anvil.

dialogue.greeting: Aye? You want something forged, or just gawking at real craftsmanship?
dialogue.about_dwarven_quality: Dwarven steel lasts generations. Your great-grandchildren will still be using what I make today.
dialogue.high_reputation: For a friend of Ironfast, I'll craft something special. Bring me the materials.

scout_brunhild.name: Scout Brunhild Stoneye
scout_brunhild.description: A lean dwarven woman with close-cropped hair and keen eyes. She moves with surprising grace for her kind.

dialogue.greeting: You don't move like a city-dweller. Mountain bred?
dialogue.about_peaks: The Shattered Peaks hide many secrets. Some should stay hidden.
dialogue.episode_05_hint: Heard rumors from the east. Marshlands stirring with activity. Might be worth investigating.
